<!-- nativecmpkit-progress:d849515b:openable-metadata -->

Provider metadata follow-up at `d849515b2a1f6048ed280e44e677f532a57d4f5f`; also relevant to #47.

`calf-io/src/androidMain/.../KmpFile.android.kt:isDirectory` no longer sends DocumentsProvider-only MIME projections to ordinary openable providers: it uses `ContentResolver.getType`, preserving document/tree handling. New `OpenableProviderMetadataTest` exercises size/name/MIME, explicit directory MIME, nullable type and denied-type/readable-size independence.

Actual local Robolectric red24:21pass/3fail, green24/24, with held source and XML archived: [red](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/d849515b2a1f6048ed280e44e677f532a57d4f5f/docs/development/evidence/openable-metadata-red-001/archive.json), [green](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/blob/d849515b2a1f6048ed280e44e677f532a57d4f5f/docs/development/evidence/openable-metadata-green-001/archive.json). This is host execution, **not proof** the original Android-device004 provider/null-size failure is fixed. API35 instrumented verification [40422019219](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40422019219) has no reviewed result yet. Cloud/ExternalStorage/Downloads, restart/grant and other original acceptance requirements remain open.
